'''Eyrie Base''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] base located in a [[Sinkhole/Legends|sinkhole]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Karatha]]. The base had a [[Eyrie Base command center|command center]].<ref name="Firepower">{{JournalCite|8|Firepower}}</ref>
